mainText: Hello, Verona! At 3 PM, here is today's balanced dish: we are seeing 60 degrees with partly cloudy skies near the Verona Area High School. We also have an ISS pass tonight, but you will not be able to see it due to the clouds.

In city news, the Verona Police Department is currently seeking new patrol officers. They are looking for dedicated individuals interested in community-oriented policing and offer specialized units like drones and e-bikes. Also, remember that a free e-waste drop-off event is scheduled for this Saturday from 8 AM to 3 PM at the Recycling Center.

There is plenty to do in town, starting with trivia at both Hop Haus and Lake Lou-ee happening today. Tomorrow, you can look forward to the Farmer's Market at Hometown Junction Park, live music at Paddy Mac's, and even more trivia at The Bogey Factory.
Regarding local safety, on September 10, officers responded to a burglary in the 600 block of Hunters Cove Way where a 19-year-old male was detained and a handgun was recovered.
For those looking for a sweet treat, please be aware that Culver's is currently closed for a remodel and will not be serving their flavor of the day.
